slides.alt: Capa marfim com o título Criar começa com uma decisão e três nós conectados: Planejar, Produzir e Revisar.

bodyLines: O que a peça precisa comunicar?
slides.alt: Três cartões geométricos representam ideias possíveis. Um círculo cobalto destaca a ideia escolhida.
Três cartões se alinham em uma composição organizada; um painel cobalto destaca o elemento principal.
Uma composição está dentro de uma moldura de revisão com três marcas: mensagem, leitura e sequência.

bodyLines: Uma revisão pode abrir um novo plano.
slides.alt: Os três nós Planejar, Produzir e Revisar retornam à primeira etapa por uma linha curva, mostrando um ciclo de ajuste.

carousel.contactLayout: All five pages, ordered, thumbnails at least 390 px wide with their page numbers visible. Save full-size pages separately.
carousel.mobilePreview: Stack all five pages scaled to 390 px width. No cropping. Inspect the 390 px artifact, not only the full-size PNGs.

timeline.motion: Cobalt first node enters over 0.4 s; line grows toward next two nodes. Heading remains still after 0.35 s.
Three cards shift by at most 32 px during first 0.5 s, then selected circle settles. Last 3.5 s holds for reading.
Cards align over first 0.6 s; main cobalt panel expands horizontally within the graphic box only. Last 3.4 s holds.
Inset frame appears over 0.4 s. Three original line marks appear sequentially at 11.5, 11.9 and 12.3 s. Hold after 12.6 s.
Return arc completes during first 0.6 s. Stable closing frame from 15.6 s to end.

reel.motionRules: Deterministic frame index. No random particles, flashes, clocks or render-time network. No text movement during reading holds. Frame 539 keeps final state; no black tail.

audio.envelope: Smooth 15 ms attack, exponential release, no discontinuous splice. Same signal on both stereo channels is acceptable; record it as dual mono.
audio.mixIntent: Soft tonal continuity and one audible scene cue per boundary, no speech. Measure output peak/RMS and inspect/listen before approval.
audio.coverage: Voice, human dialogue, speech intelligibility and lip sync are not assessed. Metrics do not prove subjective audio quality.

reel.sampling: At minimum 0, 1.5, 3.5, 5, 7.5, 9, 11.5, 13, 15.5 and 17.5 s, plus frames immediately before/after each cut. Extract from encoded master.

nativeRecipe.stage: Prepare declarative sources now; execute only after root confirms T03.
nativeRecipe.implementation: Developer authors tracked deterministic renderer using existing bundled Python/Pillow and native ffmpeg. Do not install, call a paid provider or fetch assets.
nativeRecipe.carousel: Draw vector geometry and text from this data, save editable SVG + five RGB PNGs at exact size, then assemble contact and 390 px previews.
nativeRecipe.reel: Draw frame-indexed vector frames; synthesize WAV from declared oscillators; encode 540 frames at 30 fps with original audio; extract sampling frames from the master.
nativeRecipe.pathRule: Tracked recipe/code lives under media/. Rendered files, frames, receipts and previews live under ignored output/media/. Never touch shared.css or the parent index.
nativeRecipe.rollback: Preserve failed outputs/receipts with attempt IDs. Correct only owned files. Do not delete or revert work by other agents.

acceptance: Technical receipt plus separate actual pixel/audio observation. No aesthetic self-score or 90/100 claim. No promotion of framework expertise, user approval or published status.
planningLimits: No rendering executed by production-director. This packet is an input to native executable implementation, not proof of final quality.
